summary.intent: Execute Phase 37 (parallel-batch-upload-pipeline) with wave-based parallel execution, then simplify/review the resulting code.
summary.outcome: Both plans completed successfully — SDK `uploadFiles()` batch method with p-limit concurrency (Wave 1) and Web Worker encryption offload + `useDropUpload` rewire (Wave 2). Code review fixed type duplication, task-reference comments, and a misleading worker comment.

repo: Project uses GSD (get-shit-done) workflow with wave-based parallel execution via worktrees — each plan runs in an isolated git worktree and results are merged back to the feature branch
p-limit is used for concurrency control in the SDK; was not yet installed as a dependency and needed `npm install` after plan execution
The codebase has a structured logger pattern — `console.warn/log/error` should be avoided in favor of the project logger
Phase 37 is the last phase in the current milestone
The SDK package requires a build step (`build sdk-core` then `build sdk`) before the web app can typecheck against new exports
ExternalEncryptFn type is defined in the SDK and should be reused rather than redeclared in web service files

code.finding: Originally declared a duplicate encryption result type — fixed to reuse ExternalEncryptFn return type from SDK
Defensive ArrayBuffer copy before transfer IS intentional (must copy before transferring to avoid detached buffer issues), but the comment was misleading — corrected
D-0X task-reference comments (referencing implementation task IDs) were scattered throughout — removed as noise for future maintainers
useDropUpload now calls client.uploadFiles() at line 146, replacing the prior sequential upload loop
Pre-existing Blob .buffer access issue noted by reviewers but out of scope for Phase 37

workflow: Worktree merge requires care: if the worktree HEAD detaches from the branch ref, the branch won't contain the commits — cherry-pick by commit hash is the recovery path
GSD verifier agents can produce false negatives if run before cherry-picked commits are visible on the branch — always spot-check artifact existence directly before accepting a gaps_found verdict
When multiple worktrees are active, `cd` into the wrong directory is easy — always verify CWD before git operations
Parallel executor agents use `--no-verify` on commits; orchestrator validates hooks once after wave completion
The `classifyHandoffIfNeeded is not defined` error is a Claude Code runtime bug that fires after tool calls finish — spot-check SUMMARY.md + git log to determine real success/failure

friction: Wave 2 worktree branch ref was not updated after agent commits — HEAD had commits but branch pointer was stale, causing a bad merge that imported no files
Recovery required: undo bad merge, identify correct commit hashes via detached HEAD inspection, then cherry-pick three commits individually
After cherry-picking, the orchestrator was accidentally operating from inside the worktree directory instead of the main repo, causing subsequent git operations to target the wrong repo
PROJECT.md commit initially failed because the working directory was the worktree, not the main repo
Verifier agent ran before cherry-picked Wave 2 commits were fully visible, producing false gaps_found verdict that required manual VERIFICATION.md correction across ~10 edits
p-limit was not installed as a dependency — discovered only after execution completed, requiring a manual `npm install`
SDK and sdk-core required explicit rebuild steps before web app typechecking would pass against new uploadFiles export
open_items: Upfront file buffer allocation for large batches — all three review agents flagged memory concern for large batch uploads, but fixing requires an SDK contract change; deferred because 100MB MAX_FILE_SIZE bounds worst case
Pre-existing Blob .buffer access issue in upload.service.ts — noted by code quality reviewer but out of Phase 37 scope
HUMAN-UAT.md was not created (verification passed automatically) — no human testing items were identified, but the batch upload flow should be manually tested end-to-end
Milestone is complete — `/gsd:audit-milestone` should be run before archiving
